title: PublisherManifest
description: The document that makes a government's gov-schema data findable at all. Served at /.well-known/gov-schema.json (RFC 8615), it declares who is publishing, which jurisdiction they cover, which profiles they publish, and where each one lives. Without it a consumer has no entry point: seven profiles of well-modelled data are useless if nobody can discover the URLs. This is the only document in gov-schema with a fixed, conventional location.

publisher.description: The GovernmentOrganization responsible. Required: unattributed data cannot be trusted or corrected.

specVersion.description: The gov-schema version this publisher targets, e.g. '1.0.0'. Lets a consumer detect a publisher pinned to an older profile.

conformanceLevel.description: gov-schema conformance level claimed, per SPEC section 4. Distinct from conformsTo, which names an external standard the data follows.

profileEndpoint.description: One entry per published profile. This is the routing table.

profile.description: Which gov-schema profile this endpoint serves.

dateModified.description: Lets a consumer poll cheaply instead of refetching.

catalog.description: The publisher's DataCatalog, where one exists.
